name: WorkOS
description: WorkOS is an API platform that lets software applications quickly add enterprise-ready authentication and user management, including SSO, directory sync, and audit logs, without building identity infrastructure from scratch.
best_for: Companies seeking to rapidly expand into enterprise markets without dedicating substantial engineering resources to identity infrastructure, and developers prioritizing speed-to-market for enterprise security controls.
features: Enterprise SSO with SAML and OIDC support for providers like Okta, Azure, and Google
AuthKit, a customizable authentication UI, plus social and passwordless (magic link) authentication
Directory Sync with SCIM provisioning and HRIS integrations
Role-based access control (RBAC) and audit logs with event export
Admin Portal for self-service IT admin configuration
RESTful APIs with SDKs for Node.js, Ruby, Python, Go, PHP, Java, and .NET
Radar for bot and fraud detection, and Vault for encryption key management

alternatives.name: Auth0
alternatives.description: An Okta product offering a developer-focused authentication and authorization platform with 30+ SDKs.
alternatives.best_for: Developers and B2B/B2C SaaS companies embedding customer identity into their own apps.

alternatives.name: Okta
alternatives.description: An identity security platform providing workforce identity, SSO, and adaptive MFA for employees and partners.
alternatives.best_for: Enterprises managing internal workforce access across a large pre-built integration network.
